Test Description: Assert hardware reset (rst_n_i=0) and read all I2C registers: PRERlo=0xFF, PRERhi=0xFF, CTR=0x00 (disabled), TXR=0x00, RXR=0x00, CR=0x00, SR=0x00.
Expected Result: All registers reset to specified defaults; external open-drain lines i2c_scl and i2c_sda are released (pulled high by pull-ups); bus in IDLE state.

Test Description: Set CTR[7] (EN=1) to enable I2C controller, perform configuration, then clear CTR[7] (EN=0).
Expected Result: When EN=0, internal state machines hold in idle; commands written to CR are ignored; SCL and SDA lines released high.

Test Description: Program PRER for 100 kHz Standard Mode (PRER=0x00C7 at 100 MHz clock) and 400 kHz Fast Mode (PRER=0x0031). Measure SCL clock frequency.
Expected Result: SCL toggles at exactly 100 kHz (10 us period) and 400 kHz (2.5 us period) with compliant clock low (tLOW) and clock high (tHIGH) durations.

Test Description: Write slave address to TXR; write CR with STA=1 and WR=1. Monitor serial lines.
Expected Result: i2c_sda transitions from high to low while i2c_scl remains high (compliant START condition); SR[6] (BUSY) asserts; SR[1] (TIP) asserts.

Test Description: Transmit slave address 0x50 with R/W=0 (TXR=0xA0). External VIP acts as slave and acknowledges on 9th clock cycle.
Expected Result: Master shifts 7 address bits plus write bit on i2c_sda; slave drives ACK (SDA=0) on 9th clock; master samples ACK and sets SR[7] (RxACK=0).

Test Description: Following slave address ACK, write data byte 0xA5 into TXR; issue CR with WR=1. External slave acknowledges.
Expected Result: Master shifts 8 data bits (10100101b) on i2c_sda synchronized to i2c_scl; slave drives ACK; SR[7] records 0 (ACK received); SR[1] TIP clears.

Test Scenario: Master Single-Byte Data Read with Master NACK
Test Description: Send slave address with R/W=1; write CR with RD=1, ACK=1 (NACK final byte), STO=1. External slave responds with data 0x5A.
Expected Result: Slave drives 8 bits (0x5A) on i2c_sda; master samples data into RXR; master drives SDA high on 9th clock (NACK) followed by STOP condition; RXR reads 0x5A.

Test Description: Perform write to register address, then issue CR with STA=1, WR=1, and slave address with R/W=1 without generating preceding STOP.
Expected Result: i2c_scl remains active; i2c_sda transitions high then drops low while SCL is high (Repeated START); bus ownership retained without arbitration gap.

Test Description: Write CR with STO=1 at completion of byte transfer.
Expected Result: i2c_sda transitions from low to high while i2c_scl is high (compliant STOP condition); SR[6] (BUSY) deasserts; bus returns to IDLE.

Test Description: Write 4 consecutive data bytes (0x10, 0x20, 0x30, 0x40) to I2C slave EEPROM model using sequential write commands.
Expected Result: All 4 bytes transmitted in sequence with slave ACK after each byte; SCL continues toggling without unexpected bus termination; all bytes acknowledged.

Test Scenario: Multi-Byte Sequential Read Transfer with Master ACK/NACK
Test Description: Issue sequential read for 3 bytes. Program master to drive ACK (CR[3]=0) for bytes 1 and 2, and NACK (CR[3]=1) for byte 3, followed by STOP.
Expected Result: Master acknowledges bytes 1 and 2 (SDA=0 on 9th clock); master NACKs byte 3 (SDA=1 on 9th clock); all 3 bytes captured accurately in RXR; STOP generated.

Test Scenario: Standard Mode (100 kHz) vs Fast Mode (400 kHz) Operation
Test Description: Execute identical write/read transactions at 100 kHz and 400 kHz bus speeds. Verify timing parameters (tSU:DAT, tHD:DAT, tBUF).
Expected Result: Both modes execute without protocol violations; setup and hold times satisfy Philips I2C specifications for both standard and fast modes.

Test Description: Configure PRER with extreme values: PRER=0x0002 (highest allowable bus speed) and PRER=0xFFFF (lowest clock speed).
Expected Result: Clock generation logic divides system clock reliably without counter rollover errors; SCL outputs stable waveform at both boundaries.

Test Description: External slave model holds i2c_scl low during data byte transmission to simulate slow slave processing.
Expected Result: I2C master detects SCL held low; internal state machine halts clock counter and waits until slave releases SCL before continuing clock high phase.

Test Scenario: Consecutive START and STOP Back-to-Back Sequences
Test Description: Command a START immediately followed by STOP condition in CR.
Expected Result: Master generates valid START then valid STOP with required bus free time (tBUF >= 4.7 us for standard mode) between conditions; no glitch on SDA/SCL.

Test Scenario: Slave Address NACK Detection & Bus Recovery
Test Description: Transmit non-existent slave address. External VIP withholds ACK (leaves SDA high on 9th clock).
Expected Result: Master detects NACK; SR[7] (RxACK) sets to 1; master does not lock up; CPU issues STO command and bus cleanly returns to IDLE state.

Test Scenario: Slave Data NACK Detection During Write Transfer
Test Description: Slave acknowledges address phase but withholds ACK on 2nd data byte.
Expected Result: Master detects data NACK; SR[7] (RxACK) asserts high; further data transmissions aborted; master terminates with STOP condition.

Test Description: While master is transmitting logic 1 on SDA, external stimulus pulls SDA low to simulate a competing master driving lower address.
Expected Result: Master detects SDA mismatch; SR[5] (AL) asserts high; master immediately releases SDA and SCL to high-Z and aborts transaction without disrupting competing master.

Test Scenario: Byte Transfer Complete (TIP Drop) Interrupt Assertion
Test Description: Enable interrupt in CTR[6] (IEN=1). Execute single byte write transfer. Monitor interrupt pin i2c_wb_inta_o.
Expected Result: Upon completion of 9th clock cycle, TIP bit in SR drops to 0, IF (Interrupt Flag) in SR[0] sets to 1, and i2c_wb_inta_o asserts high.
External Interface / Signal Names: None (Internal Interrupt Signal: i2c_wb_inta_o to PIC extintsrc_req[5])

Test Description: When i2c_wb_inta_o is asserted, write 1'b1 to CR[0] (IACK). Verify interrupt clear.
Expected Result: SR[0] (IF) flag clears immediately; i2c_wb_inta_o deasserts to 0; ready for subsequent transfer interrupts.

Test Scenario: PIC External Interrupt Source 5 Integration & ISR Service
Test Description: Configure VeeR PIC for external interrupt source 5 (I2C). Initiate I2C transfer with global interrupts enabled.
Expected Result: i2c_wb_inta_o pulses extintsrc_req[5]; core executes external ISR; ISR writes IACK to clear I2C interrupt and clears PIC gateway (MEIGWCLR(5)); core resumes main thread.
